title: BigCommerce Migration
seo: Migrate to BigCommerce, data and redirects
meta: Move products, customers and orders to BigCommerce with redirects for your old links. From $250, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Move your store to BigCommerce with data intact
overview: We move your catalog, customers and order history from your current platform into your BigCommerce store. First we map your fields and categories, then we run a test import and show you a sample to check. After you approve it, we run the full import and set up redirects from your old product and category links, so shoppers and search engines still land in the right place.

pkgs.blurb: Products and categories moved over with images and options.
Products, customers and redirects, with a full test pass.
A full move including order history, with launch day support.

faq: Which platforms can you move from?
Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, Wix, Squarespace and CSV exports from custom systems are all common starting points. Send us your current platform and we confirm the route before we begin.
Will my customers need new passwords?
Customer records move over, but passwords cannot be copied between platforms. Shoppers get a reset email on first login. We can draft a short note you can send ahead of launch.
We set up redirects for your old links and keep page titles and descriptions, which helps. No migration can promise unchanged rankings, but we build it to protect as much as possible.
Does my old store go offline?
No. We copy data and leave your current store running. You choose the day to switch your domain, and we help with that step if you want.
